concept: S3 encryption: SSE-KMS with a customer managed key and automatic rotation
tests: Choosing an S3 server-side encryption type with automatic yearly key rotation, control and auditing at minimal effort.
expected: SSE-KMS with a customer managed key + automatic rotation enabled (yearly), your own key policy, auditing via CloudTrail. Triggers: "rotated automatically every year", "PII", "low operational overhead".
why_not: SSE-S3 — keys fully held by AWS, no rotation control; aws/s3 (AWS managed key) — no custom key policy; client-side with keys in config — insecure and labor-intensive.
